Subject: Private VPC POC — extension & credits request (security gating)

Hi Rafael,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the engineers here were impressed with the private deployment and the VPC controls. We're headed into a formal security review next week and the security team has asked for an extended hands-on window to run a penetration test plus an integration validation with our on-prem ETL.

Quick ask: can Redwood provide an additional 30,000 token credits and extend our Private POC by 3 weeks (from Jun 10 -> Jul 1)? The extension is contingent on the SOC2 evidence and a short security appendix that your team can sign. Our procurement is fine with a conditional promo as long as we have the evidence to move forward.

Attached: ClearHealth_Security_Checklist_2026.pdf (internal requirements).

Let me know if you need anything else from our side — happy to provide a network diagram or put our security engineer on a call.

Best,
Emma Ross
